ask: Why is it on the path?
cards: The Greek line held, and with it the independence that made the classical world possible.
One afternoon ended two centuries of Persian empire and opened Asia to Alexander.
The sea battle that ended Rome's civil wars and began its emperors.
The Frankish victory that fixed the limit of the Arab advance into western Europe.
The day Anatolia began to turn Turkish, and Byzantium began its long retreat.
The Mamluks stopped the Mongols, the first time the conquerors of everywhere were turned back for good.
The last great battle of oared ships broke the spell of Ottoman invincibility at sea.
The afternoon that closed a quarter-century of world war and set Europe's order for a century.
